summary: Iteration 7, frontend only, server build /js/toolbar.min.js on / and /test-modal.html, speechSynthesis mocked. PASS: (1) HIGH fix for adaptive links with a colour theme: (a) ivory_black + darkblue_orange_brown gives rgb(114,114,255) on black, 5.57:1, light blue, no longer darkblue; (b) black_ivory + lightblue_orange_lightgreen gives rgb(46,126,153) on ivory, 4.56:1, dark blue; (c) black_green + yellow_orange_blue gives yellow link, rgb(102,102,255) visited and orange hover, so the 3 states are distinct and none is #ffffff; (d) on test-modal.html, reinforcedContrasts alone and darkblue_orange_brown alone both give on-light for the normal link (darkblue, 15.3:1) and on-dark for #dark-link (114,114,255 on #111, 5.01:1); reset removes the classes and the style. (2) i18n first visit: localStorage cleared and the locales fetch delayed 2.5 s. No null 'mainButton' error, the #confort title fills in ('Unfold Comfort+') without a reload. (3) Masks: 500/500 px on desktop and 323.5/323.5 px on Pixel 5 right after activation, pointer-events none, elementFromPoint returns #dialog-ok, #cp can be filled and #dialog-ok clicked (desktop and touch), pointermove/tap moves the band, reset removes everything. (4) Non-regressions: mobile and desktop tooltips, click/re-click, other text, Esc, right click, keyboard focus, Enter on the link being read (hash changes), sentence with a link read in full, accordion (1st tap reads + focus, 2nd tap toggles), button; the palette opens in one click with nothing read; 15 cycles of palette, mode change, settings and reload with 0 JS errors. FAIL: (A) empty-area tap then re-tap within 1 s is still silent. (B) New finding on / in case (d): a bright orange background is classed as dark and a semi-transparent background is treated as opaque, so links become light blue on orange (1.43:1) and on the peach banner (3.77:1). (C) black_green: visited and hover colours are adjusted against pure #000, not the real green background (1.2:1 and 2.6:1).

ui_bugs.issue: NOT FIXED. While text is being spoken, state === 'on', so an empty-area tap goes into the first branch: isSpokenElement is false, so it calls this.stopSpeech() (default armActivationWindow=true), then blockActivation, then returns because speakTarget is null. The stopSpeech(false) at line ~539 only runs when state !== 'on', which never happens during speech. Result: lastSpokenTarget is armed, and re-tapping the same text within 1 s hits the pass-through branch and nothing is spoken. Reproduced in a Pixel 5 touch context: tap #t1 gives state on (1 utterance), tap empty gives suspended, re-tap #t1 within 250 ms still gives suspended and 1 utterance.

isDarkBackground = relativeLuminance(bg) <= 0.4 classes mid-tone backgrounds such as orange rgb(255,121,0) (L=0.35) as dark, although black on it is 8:1 and white only 2.6:1. clearlyLinks.getEffectiveBackgroundColor also returns the first non-zero-alpha background, so rgba(255,121,0,0.1) over white (a peach banner) is parsed as opaque orange. On / with darkblue_orange_brown alone or with reinforcedContrasts (also visible in the Easy+ mode): the 'Télécharger le .xpi' CTAs get rgb(114,114,255) on orange (1.43:1, unreadable) and 'les issues GitHub du projet' gets the same colour on a near-white background (3.77:1). Fix: use the crossover threshold L <= 0.179 (or pick the side with the higher contrast), and alpha-composite semi-transparent backgrounds over their parent before classifying.
ui_bugs.selector: a.cplus-link-on-dark (homepage CTA buttons, warning banner link)

ui_bugs.issue: The light and dark variants are computed only against pure #fff and #000. On black_green (#008000 background), the dark variants keep visited rgb(102,102,255) at 1.2:1 and hover orange at 2.6:1 against the real green, so visited and hover links are unreadable. The :link yellow is fine (4.78:1). Consider adjusting against the theme's actual background colour (known from colorContrastDictionnary) or against the link's real background.

action_items: HIGH: color-contrast.service.ts applyAdaptiveLinkColor: replace the 0.4 luminance threshold with ~0.179 (or compare contrastRatio against black and white), and alpha-blend semi-transparent backgrounds (rgba with alpha < 1) with their ancestors in getEffectiveBackgroundColor or a dedicated helper. Then re-check the homepage orange CTAs and the peach warning banner link with darkblue_orange_brown alone and with reinforcedContrasts.

MEDIUM: read-aloud.service.ts onActivationGesture: in the state === 'on' branch, when !speakTarget (empty area), call this.stopSpeech(false) instead of this.stopSpeech(), so that re-tapping the same text speaks it again.

MEDIUM: buildAdaptiveLinksStyle: for themes with a mid-tone background (black_green, and probably yellow_blue / white_blue), compute the variants against the theme background rather than pure #000/#fff so that the visited and hover states stay >= 4.5:1.
critical_code_review_comments: The stopSpeech(false) change was put in a branch that is unreachable during speech: the empty-area case must be handled inside the state === 'on' block.
relativeLuminance <= 0.4 is not the correct light/dark crossover (0.179). Also, clearlyLinks.getEffectiveBackgroundColor ignores alpha < 1, which affects both features.
resolveCssColor now uses setProperty('color', c, 'important'): confirmed in the browser.
Benign: the console errors 'Failed to fetch modes-of-use.json / messages.json' only appear when a reload aborts the initial fetches.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (i18n, masks, all non-regressions and the HIGH theme combinations a/b/c pass; the empty-tap fix fails; new light/dark classification bug on mid-tone and semi-transparent backgrounds)

seed_data_creation: None. Test DOM (paragraphs, empty div, link inside a sentence, h2[aria-expanded], button) injected at runtime at the top of test-modal.html via /app/tests/inject.js.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Globals: window.cplus.{readAloud,colorContrast,...}, plus bare globals linkStyleServiceInstance, readingGuideServiceInstance, clearlyLinksServiceInstance (not on window, but reachable by bare name in evaluate). Speech mock: ctx.add_init_script(path='/app/tests/speech_mock.js'); window.__spoken holds the texts, window.__endSpeech() fires onend. Injected test elements must be at the TOP of the body (inject.js), otherwise they are below the viewport and taps miss them. Link contrast probe: page.evaluate(open('/app/tests/links_js.txt').read()). Palette cycle: JS-click #change-mode-btn, #<mode> radio, the 'Validate this mode' button, #settings-btn, #prev-toolbar inside the shadow root. route.navigate needs (route, shouldLoad, root), so do not call it directly. Homepage links on the orange CTAs and the peach banner are the regression case for the light/dark classification.
